title: Reachable symbol-level finding with an available fix
code_snippet:
$ govulncheck ./... ; echo rc=$?
=== Symbol Results ===

Vulnerability #1: GO-2024-0001
  Module: example.com/vmod
    Found in: example.com/vmod@v1.0.0
    Fixed in: example.com/vmod@v1.2.0
    Example traces found:
      #1: main.main calls vmod.Vuln

Your code is affected by 1 vulnerability from 1 module.
rc=3

# Auditor's report:
# "Low priority — no CVSS published, so severity is unknown."
expected_feedback: P0: GO-2024-0001 is an E1 Called finding — govulncheck placed it under === Symbol Results === with a trace from main, and a fix version (v1.2.0) exists. The absence of a CVSS score is expected: the Go vulnerability database does not publish severity scores, so it can never be a reason to downgrade. Priority comes from the evidence tier.
